steps.en: Officer opens the ad-hoc query page
steps.why_en: The page is switched off and cannot be opened
steps.why_id: Halaman dimatikan sehingga tidak bisa dibuka

steps.en: Officer enters the company ID number
steps.why_en: No form or request exists for a single lookup
steps.why_id: Tidak ada form atau request untuk satu pencarian

steps.en: The company ID goes to the data source for notices already in the system
steps.id: ID perusahaan dikirim ke sumber data untuk notice yang sudah ada
steps.why_en: The job is switched off in production and there is no officer-triggered query
steps.why_id: Job dimatikan di produksi dan tidak ada query yang dipicu officer

steps.en: Company details come back and show on the notice
steps.id: Detail perusahaan kembali dan tampil di notice
steps.why_en: Only a few company fields are shown, per notice, and data may be empty in production
steps.why_id: Hanya sedikit field perusahaan yang tampil, per notice, dan data bisa kosong di produksi
